reqBaseAnnouncement.remarks: BANK OF CEYLON - ISSUE UP TO HUNDRED MILLION (100,000,000) BASEL III COMPLIANT TIER 2 LISTED RATED UNSECURED SUBORDINATED REDEEMABLE 5 YEAR (2026/2031) AND 7 YEAR (2026/2033) DEBENTURES WITH NON VIABILITY WRITE DOWN FEATURES AT AN ISSUE PRICE OF LKR 100 EACH TO RAISE A SUM OF UP TO SRI LANKAN RUPEES TEN BILLION (LKR 10,000,000,000/-), WITH AN OPTION TO ISSUE UPTO A FURTHER HUNDRED MILLION (100,000,000) OF SAID DEBENTURES TO INCREASE THE SAID SUM BY UP TO A FURTHER SRI LANKAN RUPEES TEN BILLION(LKR 10,000,000,000/-), AT THE DISCRETION OF THE BANK IN THE EVENT OF AN OVERSUBSCRIPTION OF THE INITIAL ISSUE AND WITH A FURTHER OPTION TO ISSUE UPTO A FURTHER HUNDRED MILLION (100,000,000) OF SAID DEBENTURES TO INCREASE THE SAID SUM BY UP TO A FURTHER SRI LANKAN RUPEES TEN BILLION (LKR 10,000,000,000/-), AT THE DISCRETION OF THE BANK IN THE EVENT OF AN OVERSUBSCRIPTION OF THE INITIAL ISSUE AND THE SECOND TRANCHE.
reqBaseAnnouncement.title: DEBENTURE ISSUE(BASIS OF ALLOTMENT)
